create_calibrate_planar_embedding: create a CalibratePlanarEmbedding module to apply learnable 2D offset calibration to ray origins
create_calibrate_embedding: create a CalibrateEmbedding module to apply per-view pose and time offset calibration to rays
create_ray_prediction_embedding: create a RayPredictionEmbedding module to predict point and ray outputs from parameterized ray features
create_ray_intersect_embedding: create a RayIntersectEmbedding module to compute ray intersections using a configurable intersect function
create_create_rays_embedding: create a CreateRaysEmbedding module to construct new rays from input points and ray directions
